# Existing-only updates require --force before rewriting remote history.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-08-05T12:30:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'

shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add feature.txt
gs branch create feature -m feature
gs branch submit --fill

git add rewrite.txt
git commit --amend --no-edit

! gs branch submit --update-only --existing-only --fill
stderr 'existing-only submission would rewrite branch "feature"; rerun with --force'

gs branch submit --update-only --existing-only --force --fill
shamhub dump changes
stdout '"number": 1'
! stdout '"number": 2'

-- repo/feature.txt --
feature
-- repo/rewrite.txt --
rewrite
